parent_v2_1.key_result: 0/64 truth unique from positives, 2/64 with complete negatives, 6/64 after exact movement timing despite orthogonal A/B/M activation
parent_v2_1.rule: v2.1 is immutable; v2.2 only adds new evidence channels

scientific_question: Which direct axis-specific observations are sufficient to collapse the residual BAM equivalence classes left by complete occurrence, perfect-negative and movement-timing evidence?

evidence_semantics.direct_A: Independent abiotic-state observation at a node: whether the focal species is physiologically/experimentally viable there when B and M are held out of the measurement.
evidence_semantics.direct_B: Independent biotic-permissibility observation at a node: whether the local partner/antagonist configuration permits the focal species when A and M are held out of the measurement.
evidence_semantics.direct_M: Exact source-conditioned first-arrival timing already defined in v2.1; no new M evidence is invented in v2.2.

evidence_ladder: E1 E0 + perfect surveyed negatives (complete G)
E2 E1 + exact first-arrival times on truth-positive nodes

unit_of_identification.world_identity: Exact candidate parameter tuple; reported but not the primary endpoint because different parameter tuples can induce identical A/B/M states on a finite landscape.
unit_of_identification.bam_state_identity: Primary endpoint. Two worlds are BAM-state equivalent only if A set, B set, M set, and first-arrival vector are identical.
unit_of_identification.rationale: Do not label parameter aliases as biological non-identifiability when they are observationally and mechanistically identical on the declared finite landscape.

direct_measurement_policy.full_axis_endpoint: Expose the complete truth A or B state across all 21 nodes to measure the maximum information available from that axis.
direct_measurement_policy.minimal_targeted_endpoint: Greedily choose diagnostic nodes that maximally split the current compatible BAM-state classes; ties resolved lexicographically and frozen before reading the next axis.

primary_hypotheses.claim: No evidence ladder can distinguish candidate worlds that are identical in A, B, M and arrival state; these parameter aliases must remain one BAM-state equivalence class.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any split within an exact BAM-state equivalence class refutes H1.

primary_hypotheses.claim: When residual E2-compatible BAM states differ in A, complete direct-A observations eliminate every state whose A set differs from truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any A-mismatched state surviving complete A evidence refutes H2.

primary_hypotheses.claim: After E3, complete direct-B observations eliminate every residual state whose B set differs from truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any B-mismatched state surviving complete B evidence refutes H3.

primary_hypotheses.claim: After complete G, M timing, A and B evidence, the compatible set collapses to the exact truth BAM-state equivalence class for every eligible truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any non-equivalent BAM state surviving E4 refutes H4.

primary_hypotheses.claim: A finite targeted set of direct A/B node measurements can reproduce the full-axis BAM-state contraction for every eligible truth whose residual ambiguity is axis-separable.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Report rather than force success: cases requiring all nodes or remaining unresolved are retained.

forbidden_after_results: count parameter aliases as distinct biological mechanisms in the primary endpoint
add a new evidence channel after E4 to rescue a failed H4
